text:
jordan: I opened a small PR that adds a minimal NAT traversal section for Private installs + a short checklist for signing and checksum verification of offline bundles. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4971

natalie: will review. quick heads-up: in the NAT section we should call out hairpin NAT behavior on older edge routers (packets may be DNATed back to external IP -> broken loopback). maybe add a troubleshooting bullet?

jordan: good call. I added a troubleshooting bullet and an example `iptables` DNAT rule to avoid common mistakes. also included a small `openssl sha256` example for checksum verification.

rachel: on the HSM note 12: our HSM partner's docs say 5698/tcp for control and 5699/tcp for admin commands. do we want to recommend both? some customers lock down admin.

tariq: recommend documenting both ports but mark 5699 as optional/admin-only. most installs only need 5698. add an example Service/Firewall snippet.

jordan: added a Service example for kube manifests and a bare-metal firewall snippet. sample firewall block:

```yaml
# minimal firewall for redwood private
- proto: tcp
  port: 443
  desc: installer downloads
- proto: tcp
  port: 5698
  desc: hsm control
- proto: tcp
  port: 5699
  desc: hsm admin (optional)
```

natalie: tiny wording nit: prefer "allowlist" over "whitelist" per style guide. also for the offline bundle checksum section, can we call out GPG signing as optional but higher security for air-gapped sites?

jordan: swapped to "allowlist" and added a short paragraph recommending GPG-signed artifact verification with an example gnupg command.

docs-bot: Lint: OK. Broken links: 1 (vendor HSM admin doc link). Will auto-open issue if not fixed in next commit.

rachel: couple more edge cases:
- SELinux: when extracting the bundle on RHEL/CentOS, file contexts can block the installer. suggest `restorecon -R /opt/offline-bundles` after extract.
- Path length: some older filesystems fail if filename > 256. suggest example path `/opt/offline/redwood-2026-02.tar.gz`.

jordan: added SELinux note and tightened the recommended path length wording. thanks.

tariq: I ran a quick smoke on our semi-airgapped staging (mirror + internal registry):
```
[2026-03-02T22:04:10Z] start installer
[2026-03-02T22:04:33Z] fetch: mirror -> 200
[2026-03-02T22:04:40Z] verify: sha256 OK
[2026-03-02T22:04:52Z] extract: ok
[2026-03-02T22:05:10Z] service: kms -> connected
[2026-03-02T22:05:12Z] service: hsm -> handshake OK
[2026-03-02T22:05:20Z] health: http://localhost:8080/health -> 200
SMOKE: PASS
```

tariq: one flake: mirror returned 502 on first attempt, installer retried and succeeded. added note to docs to retry downloads up to 3 times.

natalie: can we also add a short `conn-checker` script snippet that validates port-forwarding + TLS cert chain? would be useful for support tickets.

jordan: added a 5-line bash snippet to the PR. snippet checks TCP connect and `openssl s_client` for cert chain.

rachel: last ask: include a line about local time sync (NTP/chrony) as HSMs sometimes reject sessions with >5s drift. customers trip on this.

jordan: added note and moved the time-sync bullet into the preflight checklist. merging after CI green and link fix. filing follow-up issue #4972 to add annotated screenshots and `conn-checker` output examples.

docs-bot: CI: pending. Will comment on PR with lint/link issues when CI finishes.
